source.title: Khorium Plated Bludgeon — archived Allakhazam first-person disenchant comment on Wowhead TBC Classic
source.author: Allakhazam (archived comment; original author unidentified)

quote: I had one "of the Monkey". It Disenchanted into 3 arcane dust.
notes: The source's historical TBC Classic item page identifies Khorium Plated Bludgeon as an uncommon one-hand mace at item level 105 and the comment identifies the random suffix 'of the Monkey'. One actual item was disenchanted into three Arcane Dust. Single first-person positive cast; not a group or current Retail probability. Current-game eligibility, original comment publication date, build, skill and specialization are not supplied. Allakhazam comment mirrored on Wowhead; do not count localized page copies as new studies.
